content.text: Let me get the link URLs and fetch all pages via eval.

input.command: orca eval --expression "(async()=>{const links=[...document.querySelectorAll('a')].map(a=>a.href);const urls=[location.href,...new Set(links.filter(h=>!h.includes('Next')))];const seen=new Set();const rows=[];for(const u of [...new Set(urls)]){const t=await (await fetch(u)).text();const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(t,'text/html');for(const tr of d.querySelectorAll('tbody tr, table tr')){const c=[...tr.querySelectorAll('td')].map(x=>x.textContent.trim());if(c.length&&!seen.has(c[0])){seen.add(c[0]);rows.push(c);}}}const m=rows.filter(r=>r[1].trim().toLowerCase()==='northwind'&&r[3].trim().toLowerCase()==='overdue');return JSON.stringify({links,n:rows.length,m,variants:[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r[1]+'|'+r[3]))]})})()" --json
